term.label: sequence_variant_causing_conservative_missense_codon_change_in_transcript

definition.text: The amino acid change following from the codon change does not change the gross properties (size, charge, hydrophobicity) of the amino acid at that position.

comments: The exact rules need to be stated, a common set of rules can be derived from e.g. BLOSUM62 amino acid distance matrix.

synonyms.value: sequence variant causing conservative missense codon change in transcript
mutation causing conservative missense codon change in transcript
